name: ML4CO-Bench-101-MAML
description: A benchmark for evaluating meta-learning (MAML-style) approaches on combinatorial optimization problems. It measures how well learned policies generalize across problem instances by comparing solution quality and optimality gaps on held-out instances. The benchmark focuses on sequential decision-making behavior and objective value improvement rather than natural language outputs.
reputation: Part of the ML4CO suite; recognized within the ML-for-optimization community but not widely used outside specialist researchers.
